correctness.rationale: Normalized complex Hermite decomposition of full order-two Gaussian Fock space has one scalar angular sector -1 and a 2x2 sector for each j>=1. Direct incomplete gamma integration gives A_x^(j)=I_j(x)I+E_j(x)[[0,sqrt(j)],[sqrt(j),j-1-x]], E_j=e^-x*x^j/j!. Thus [A_x,A_y]^(j)=(x-y)*sqrt(j)*E_j(x)E_j(y)[[0,1],[-1,0]], yielding exactly singular pair s_j=|x-y|sqrt(j)e^-(x+y)(xy)^j/(j!)^2 and one-dimensional kernel, all Schatten orders by factorial decay. Adjacent ratio q/sqrt(j(j+1)^3) gives mode switch. Strict log-concavity of branch objective gives unique x_j,y_j; Robbins factorial remainders imply each maximum M_j < 1/(pi sqrt(2e)), Stirling shows convergence to that sharp but unattained supremum. Independent numeric 18 block commutators, several M_j, and symbolic radial identities corroborated. Only full order2 centered disks, not individual true levels or off-center disks.
